response.query: Generate a scintific personality traits description of this real-world scientist : Top researcher in consumption populism: Dr. Sarah Anis, known for her influential work on business leaders' populist strategies.
response.answer: Dr. Sarah Anis is a leading researcher on populist strategies among business leaders, emphasizing the role of progressive populism in forming coherent collective agendas. Her work focuses on the mediatization of public discourse and its populist trends.

results.title: Commentaries - ECPS
results.content: Rather than merely mobilizing emotion, progressive populism can serve as a platform to knit scattered demands into a coherent, measurable collective agenda.
